_comment: Contract: Divination routing request input — JSON format

field_types.divination_types: array of strings — each must be one of: 'gematria', 'bazi', 'numerology'. Max 3 types.
field_types.name: string (1-80 chars, alphabetic + spaces/hyphens/apostrophes) — required for gematria and numerology
field_types.date_of_birth: string YYYY-MM-DD — required for bazi and numerology. Must be ≤ today, ≥ 150 years in past.
field_types.time_of_birth: string HH:MM (24-hour) or null — optional for gematria/numerology; triggers house warning for bazi if absent
field_types.location.city: string — required for bazi. City name recognized by geocoder lookup table.
field_types.location.nation: string ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 — recommended for bazi, inferred from city if omitted.
field_types.timezone: string IANA identifier — optional for bazi; inferred from city lookup if absent.
field_types.gematria_systems: array of strings — for gematria only. Supported: 'english', 'hebrew', 'simple'. Default: ['english']
field_types.numerology_systems: array of strings — for numerology only. Supported: 'pythagorean', 'chaldean'. Default: ['pythagorean']
